title: Choose the landing page's structure
question: The world is settled (the galley). This is composition only: which structure carries the first viewport?

options.label: The Appeal
options.thesis: The first viewport is a real evidence packet — the record a student could appeal with — assembling itself line by line.
options.viewport: Wordmark and a one-line thesis at the top. Below, a packet: 'Evidence packet · taskflow-springboot · at 9f3c2a1d · 1 of 5 verified', then three findings typeset with their margin checks — VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, LOOKED·NOT FOUND — each locator and quote arriving one after another as if being filed. The primary action, 'Open the workspace', sits under the thesis. Features follow as a short galley: six lines, one rule.
options.risk: A document-as-hero can read quiet on a projector; the assembling motion and the contradiction line have to carry it.

regions.label: evidence packet — three findings, filing in

options.label: Index of Checks
options.thesis: The first viewport is the rubric as a numbered checklist; each line resolves to its state in turn, and one of them says 'stays with you'.
options.viewport: Wordmark and thesis left; a six-line checklist right — 'JWT authentication', 'Role-based authorization', 'Caching layer', 'Automated tests', 'Code quality', 'Creativity' — each with an empty margin that fills: ✓, ✗ with 'report claims five roles', —, ◐, ◐, and 'stays with you'. The action sits under the thesis. Features below as the same checklist grammar.
options.risk: A checklist hero is the category's most familiar shape; the 'stays with you' line and the contradiction have to do the differentiating.

options.label: Claim vs. Evidence
options.lineage: the README beside what the code shows
options.thesis: Two columns on one rule: the submitter's claims typeset on the left, what RepoMan found on the right, and the one that doesn't hold is struck through.
options.viewport: Wordmark and thesis across the top. Left column headed 'The README says': 'JWT authentication · full RBAC across five tiers · Redis caching · comprehensive tests'. Right column headed 'The code shows': each claim's finding lands beside it with its locator; 'five tiers' gets a pencil strike and 'two roles — UserRole.java:7–12'. Action under the thesis. Features below in the same two-column grammar.
options.risk: Strong on the mechanism, but strike-through on a claim can read as accusation on a Persuade surface; the copy must stay evidentiary.
